slides.title: Kirish: siqilish sindromi va mavzuning dolzarbligi

bullets.text: Yer silkinishi, ko‘chki, portlash, bino qulashi kabi ofatlar va baxtsiz hodisalar so‘nggi yillarda tez-tez sodir bo‘lmoqda.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Ofatlarning og‘ir oqibatlaridan biri siqilish sindromi (crush syndrome, CS). U og‘ir mushak shikastining butun organizmdagi ko‘rinishidir.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: 2023-yilgi Turkiya va Suriya zilzilasida 47 000 dan ortiq odam halok bo‘lgan. Bunday ofatlarda CS keng uchraydigan jiddiy shikastdir.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Ma’ruza maqsadi: CS sabablari, mexanizmi, belgilari, diagnostikasi, davosi, asoratlari va kelajakdagi yo‘nalishlarini ko‘rib chiqish.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 4 daqiqa. Muhokama: 1) Nega ofatlarda siqilish sindromi ko‘p uchraydi? 2) Sud-tibbiyot ekspertiga bu mavzu nima uchun kerak? Doskada chizish: «Ofat → ezilish → CS» qisqa strelkali sxema. Tipik xato: CS ni oddiy mahalliy jarohat deb tushunish. U tizimli holat ekanini ta’kidlang.

slides.title: Ma’ruza rejasi: bo‘limlar zanjiri

bullets.text: Reja Usuda sharhi tuzilishiga tayanadi: sabab, mexanizm, belgilar, diagnostika, davo, asoratlar.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Guo maqolasi diagnostikadagi bahslarni va jarohat mexanizmi bo‘yicha tasnifni to‘ldiradi.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

bullets.text: Ofat sharoitida davoni imkon qadar erta boshlash o‘limni kamaytiruvchi eng muhim omil sanaladi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 3 daqiqa. Muhokama: 1) Nega diagnostikadan keyin mexanizm bo‘yicha tasnif keladi? 2) Davolash qaysi bosqichlarga bog‘liq? Doskada chizish: besh bosqichli zanjirni talabalar bilan birga chizing. Tipik xato: bo‘limlar tartibini aralashtirish, masalan davoni diagnostikadan oldin qo‘yish.

slides.title: Siqilish shikasti (CI) va sindrom (CS): farqi

bullets.text: Siqilish shikasti (crush injury, CI) — tananing bevosita ezilishi; ko‘pincha oyoqlarda uchraydi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: CS — ezilgan mushakning tizimli ko‘rinishi; Bywaters va Beall 1941-yilda tasvirlagan.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Diqqat: CI ≠ CS — shikast to‘qimada, sindrom esa butun organizmda namoyon bo‘ladi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

columns.title: CI
items: Misol: Oyoq mushak, suyak, teri shikasti

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daqiqa. Muhokama: 1) Bemorda faqat mahalliy ezilish bo‘lsa, uni CS deyish mumkinmi? 2) Ekspertiza xulosasida CI va CS atamalari nima uchun aralashmasligi kerak? Doskada chizish: CI doirasi va uni o‘rab turuvchi CS doirasini chizing. Tipik xato: CI va CS ni sinonim deb ishlatish.

slides.title: Tarixi: Messina 1901 va Bywaters 1941

bullets.text: Ezilish sindromi (CS) birinchi marta 1901 yilgi Messina zilzilasida (Italiya) kuzatilgan.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: London bombardimonida soatlab ko‘milganlar otopsiyasida buyrak kanalchalarida qo‘ng‘ir pigment topildi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: 1941 yilda Bywaters va hamkasblari pigment bilan mushak nekrozi o‘rtasidagi aloqani tasvirladi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega otopsiya CS tarixida hal qiluvchi bo‘ldi? 2) Sud-tibbiy ekspert buyrak kanalchalaridan nimani qidiradi? Doskada: 4 bosqichli vaqt chizig‘ini chizdiring. Tipik xato: 1901 (birinchi kuzatuv) va 1941 (birinchi ilmiy tasvir) sanalarini aralashtirish. Manbada pigment ‘qo‘ng‘ir pigment’ deb yozilgan, uni mustaqil ravishda boshqa nom bilan atamang.

slides.title: Epidemiologiya: uchrash va o‘lim ko‘rsatkichlari

bullets.text: Zilzilada omon qolganlar orasida CS uchrashi tizimli sharhda 2–15% deb xabar qilingan.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: O‘lim 48% gacha yetgan. Omon qolish uchun buyrak disfunksiyasini cheklash va a’zolar funksiyasini qo‘llab-quvvatlash zarur bo‘lgan.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: To‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri jarohatdan keyin CS zilzilada o‘limning ikkinchi eng ko‘p uchraydigan sababidir.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: CS jarohatdan keyin atigi 1 soatdayoq boshlanishi mumkin.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama: 1) 2–15% va 48% qaysi ko‘rsatkichlarni anglatadi? 2) Nega o‘lim holatlarida CS tashxisi sud-tibbiy ekspert uchun muhim? Doskada: ikki ustun chizing: ‘Uchrash 2–15%’ va ‘O‘lim ≤48%’. Diqqat: xato qilish xavfi — uchrash ko‘rsatkichi (2–15%) bilan o‘lim ko‘rsatkichini (48% gacha) aralashtirmang.

slides.title: Tezkor savol 1: asosiy tushunchalar

bullets.text: 1-savol: ezilish jarohati (CI) va CS farqi nima? Javob: CI — to‘qima jarohati; CS — tizimli belgilar bilan kechadigan ezilish jarohati.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: 2-savol: CS ta’rifi qanday? Javob: og‘ir travmatik mushak jarohatining tizimli ko‘rinishi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: 3-savol: kim va qachon tasvirlagan? Javob: Bywaters va hamkasblari, 1941 yil; birinchi kuzatuv — Messina, 1901 yil.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: 4-savol: ko‘rsatkichlar? Javob: uchrashi 2–15%, o‘lim 48% gacha, boshlanishi 1 soatdan.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 4 daq. Talabalar javobni yopiq daftarda yozadi, so‘ng tekshiriladi. Muhokama: CI ‘to‘qima’, CS ‘tizim’ darajasi degani nimani bildiradi? Doskada: ikki pog‘onali sxema — CI → (tizimli belgilar) → CS. Tipik xato: CI va CS tushunchalarini bir xil deb hisoblash.

slides.title: Siqilish shikasti: sabablari va joylashuvi

bullets.text: Siqilish shikasti (CI) tananing to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri jismoniy zarbasi va bosilishidan kelib chiqadi. Eng ko‘p pastki oyoq-qo‘llar shikastlanadi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Sabablari: yo‘l-transport hodisalari, zilzila, ko‘chki, shaxta halokati, portlash, bino qulashi, terror hujumi va urush.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Teri, mushak-paylar, suyak va bo‘g‘imlar birga shikastlanadi. Hayotiy a’zolar zararlanmasa ham, ayniqsa oyoq-qo‘lda shikast hayot uchun xavfli bo‘lishi mumkin.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: AQSh kohort tadqiqotida CI o‘tkir kompartment sindromi (ACS) ehtimolini oshirgan (OR 1,83). Bolalarda CI kam uchraydi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega hayotiy a’zolar shikastlanmasa ham oyoq-qo‘l siqilishi o‘limga olib kelishi mumkin? 2) Sud-tibbiy ekspertizada shikast sharoitini (zilzila, avtohalokat) aniqlash nimaga kerak? Doskaga chizing: tana sxemasi va unda siqilish shikastlari eng ko‘p uchraydigan pastki oyoq-qo‘llar. Tipik xato: siqilish shikasti (CI, to‘qima shikasti) va siqilish sindromi (CS, tizimli oqibatlar bilan) ni aralashtirish.

slides.title: Ko‘krak va qorin siqilish shikastlari

bullets.text: Ko‘krak siqilishida tez aralashuv, erta tashxis va jarrohlik tiklash asoratlarni kamaytiradi. Yuqori ko‘krak shikasti traxeya uzilishiga olib kelishi mumkin.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Xitoy tadqiqotida ko‘krak va qo‘l siqilish sindromi og‘ir va tez kechishiga CO zaharlanishi, mastlik va a’zolarning bir-biriga bosilishi sabab bo‘lgan.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Og‘ir qorin siqilishi tayanch-harakat, siydik, yurak-qon tomir, teri va hazm tizimlariga ta’sir qiladi. Ichak tutqichi yirtilsa kuchli qon ketadi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Qon ketishi gemorragik shok va ko‘p a’zo yetishmovchiligiga olib keladi. Suyak sinishi ham arterial qon ketishi orqali shokni chaqirishi mumkin.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 7 daq. Muhokama: 1) Qorin siqilishida o‘lim sababini sud-tibbiy jihatdan qanday asoslaysiz? 2) Ko‘krak siqilishida nafas yetishmovchiligi mexanizmi qanday? Doskaga chizing: qorin siqilishi, ichak tutqichi yirtilishi, qon ketishi, gemorragik shok va ko‘p a’zo yetishmovchiligi zanjiri. Tipik xato: faqat tashqi belgilarga qarab ichki a’zo shikastini inkor etish.

slides.title: Chanoq qon tomir shikastlari

bullets.text: Chanoq qon tomir shikastlari odatda yuqori energiyali travma natijasida yuzaga keladi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Ko‘pchiligi yo‘l-transport to‘qnashuvlaridan, qolgani yiqilish yoki sanoatdagi siqilish shikastlaridan bo‘ladi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Ular ko‘pincha chanoq halqasi uzilishi bilan birga keladi. Chanoqdagi qon ketishidan shok rivojlanib, o‘lim darajasi yuqori bo‘ladi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Erta ko‘p qatlamli kompyuter tomografiyasi (KT) bilan aniqlanib, tezda davolansa, qon ketishdan o‘lim oldini olinishi yoki qaytarilishi mumkin.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Chanoq halqasi uzilishida o‘lim nega aynan qon ketishi va shokdan bo‘ladi? 2) Erta KT natijasi o‘lim sababini aniqlashda qanday ahamiyatga ega? Doskaga chizing: yuqori energiyali travma, chanoq halqasi uzilishi, chanoq qon ketishi, shok, o‘lim. Tipik xato: chanoq shikastini faqat suyak sinishi deb baholab, qon tomir shikastini unutish.

slides.title: Voqea tahlili 1: qulagan bino ostidagi shaxs

bullets.text: Vaziyat: bino qulaganda shaxs bir necha soat vayronalar ostida qolgan. Oyoqlari uzoq siqilgan, tashqi shikast esa kam ko‘rinadi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Diqqat: xato qilish xavfi! Siqilish shikasti (CI) ≠ siqilish sindromi (CS). CI — to‘qima shikasti, CS — tizimli belgilar bilan kechadigan CI.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: CS belgilari: hujayralardan kaliy, ferment va mioglobin chiqadi. Kech bosqichda gipovolemik shok, giperkaliemiya va metabolik asidoz paydo bo‘ladi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Savol: bu CI mi yoki CS mi? Teri shikasti kam bo‘lsa ham, shishgan oyoq, shok, mioglobinuriya va buyrak yetishmovchiligi CS dalolati.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) CI va CS ni qaysi belgilar farqlaydi? 2) Tashqi shikast kam bo‘lishi nega xavfli? Doskaga chizish: ikki ustunli ro‘yxat — CI (mahalliy to‘qima shikasti) va CS (tizimli belgilar). Tipik xato: talabalar CI va CS ni bir xil tushuncha deb hisoblaydi.

slides.title: Siqilish mexanizmi: bosim va to‘qima shikasti

bullets.text: Ezuvchi kuch qon tomirlardagi siqilmaydigan qonga ta’sir qiladi va to‘qima bosimini keskin oshiradi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Kechikkan yallig‘lanish shikast zonasini kengaytiradi va dastlab shikast og‘irligini yashirishi mumkin.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Bo‘lma ichi bosimi kapillyar perfuziya bosimidan oshsa, mushak va nerv to‘qimasi ishemiyaga uchraydi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega dastlabki ko‘rikda shikast og‘irligi kam baholanadi? 2) Bo‘lma ichi bosimi qachon xavfli bo‘ladi? Doskaga chizish: sxemadagi 5 bosqichni strelkalar bilan chizing. Tipik xato: faqat teri ko‘rinishiga qarab xulosa qilish.

slides.title: Ishemiya-reperfuziya (IR) shikasti

bullets.text: IR shikasti: qon oqimi tiklanganda rivojlanadigan o‘tkir yallig‘lanish, mahalliy va tizimli ta’sirli.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Patofiziologiya o‘zini kuchaytiruvchi shish–ishemiya halqasiga asoslanadi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Mushak 2–4 soat chidaydi deb hisoblangan, ammo qaytmas o‘zgarishlar 1 soatdayoq boshlanishi mumkin.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Qon oqimi tiklanishi nega zararni kuchaytirishi mumkin? 2) 1 soat va 2–4 soat chegarasi sud-tibbiy baholashda nimani anglatadi? Doskaga chizish: shish–ishemiya doiraviy halqasini chizing. Tipik xato: reperfuziyani faqat foydali jarayon deb o‘ylash.

slides.title: Mioglobin va o‘tkir buyrak shikasti (AKI)

bullets.text: Uzoq ishemiyada hujayra membranasi o‘tkazuvchanligi oshadi; hujayradan kaliy, ferment va mioglobin chiqadi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Mioglobin buyrak kanalchalarida cho‘kib, temir va oksidlovchi stress orqali ularni bevosita shikastlaydi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Ferroptoz (temir ortiqchaligi, lipid perokidlanishi) tilga olinadi, ammo CS-AKIdagi mexanizmi noaniq.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5-6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nima uchun mioglobin aynan buyrak kanalchalariga zarar yetkazadi? 2) Ferroptoz haqida nimani aniq aytish mumkin, nimani yo‘q? Doskada chizish: zanjirni chizib, har bosqich yoniga sud-tibbiy topshiriqni yozing (jasad ochishda buyrak kanalchalarini qidirish). Qo‘shimcha: Bywaters 1941 yilda o‘lganlarning buyrak kanalchalarida jigarrang pigmentni topgan; gipotenziya bilan birga o‘tkir kanalchalar nekrozi va uremiyaga olib keladi. Tipik xato: ferroptoz mexanizmi isbotlangan, deb aytish – manbada uning roli noaniq deyilgan.

slides.title: Ferroptoz va mioglobin: AKI mexanizmi

bullets.text: Mioglobin buyrak kanalchalarida cho‘kib, temir va oksidlovchi stress orqali kanalcha epiteliysini bevosita shikastlaydi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Ferroptozning xos belgilari: temir ortiqchaligi va lipidlar peroksidlanishi shikasti.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Ferroptozni yallig‘lanish sitokinlari va shikast bilan bog‘liq molekulalar (HMGB1, ikki zanjirli DNK, makrofag tuzoqlari) kuchaytiradi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: CS-AKI da ferroptoz mexanizmi va uning terapevtik nishon bo‘la olishi hali noaniq; gipotenziya bilan birga o‘tkir kanalcha nekrozi va uremiyaga olib keladi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 3 daqiqa. Muhokama: nega ferroptoz davolash nishoni sifatida hali tavsiya etilmaydi? Doskada: mexanizm daraxti. Tipik xato: ferroptozni isbotlangan davo nishoni deb hisoblash.
slides.diagram_note: Manbada ferroptozning CS-AKI dagi mexanizmi va terapevtik nishon bo‘lishi noaniq deb ko‘rsatilgan.

slides.title: Tizimli belgilar: erta va kech

bullets.text: Diqqat: siqilish jarohati (CI) ≠ siqilish sindromi (CS): CI – to‘qima jarohati, CS – tizimli belgilar bilan kechadi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Giperkaliemiya va metabolik atsidoz hayot uchun xavfli; o‘lim ko‘pincha gipovolemiya va giperkaliemiyadan.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: O‘tkir buyrak shikasti (AKI) CS dan o‘limning yetakchi sababi sifatida ko‘rsatilgan.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama: 1) CI va CS farqi sud-tibbiy xulosada nega muhim? 2) O‘lim sababini aniqlashda qaysi belgilar kechki davrga xos? Doskada chizish: jadvalni ko‘chirib, har davrga bittadan klinik misol yozing. Tipik xato: CI va CS ni bir xil tushuncha deb olish; DVS ni erta belgi deb hisoblash (manbada u juda kech holatlarda uchraydi).

slides.title: Tezkor savol 2: mexanizm zanjiri

bullets.text: Savol: reperfuziya, mushak ishemiyasi, buyrak shikasti va mioglobin chiqishini to‘g‘ri ketma-ketlikka tering.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Javob: uzoq mushak ishemiyasi → reperfuziya (bosim olingach) → mioglobin va kaliy chiqishi → buyrak shikasti.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Savol: kaliy bu zanjirda qanday xavf tug‘diradi? Javob: ekstrikatsiyadan so‘ng giperkaliemiya xavfi bor, aritmiya mumkin.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 3 daq. Talabalarga kartochkalarda to‘rt bosqichni berib, 1 daqiqada tartiblatib, keyin kaliy rolini so‘rang. Muhokama: nima uchun xavf aynan bosim olingan paytda oshadi? Doskada chizish: to‘rt bosqichli o‘q chizig‘i, kaliy uchun alohida shox. Tipik xato: reperfuziyani zararsiz bosqich deb o‘ylash – manbada u yallig‘lanish va mushak shikastini kuchaytiradi.

slides.title: Voqea tahlili 2: ozod qilingandan keyingi holat

bullets.text: Vaziyat: uzoq qamalgan jabrlanuvchi ozod qilingach ahvoli yomonlashdi. Savol: reperfuziya va giperkaliemiya xavfi qanday bog‘liq?

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Uzoq ishemiya hujayra membranasini o‘tkazuvchan qiladi: hujayralar kaliy, ferment va mioglobin chiqaradi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Qon qayta oqqanda (reperfuziya) yallig‘lanish boshlanadi, neytrofillar mushak shikastini kuchaytiradi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Ozod qilingach giperkaliemiya (qonda kaliy oshishi) xavfi bor; asosiy davo — vena ichiga suyuqlik, kaliysiz eritma, imkon bo‘lsa ozod qilishdan oldin.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega ahvol aynan ozod qilingandan keyin yomonlashishi mumkin? 2) Nega suyuqlikda kaliy bo‘lmasligi muhim? Doskada: ishemiya → ozod qilish → reperfuziya → kaliy, mioglobin chiqishi zanjirini chizing. Tipik xato: reperfuziyani faqat foydali jarayon deb o‘ylash; u qo‘shimcha shikast ham beradi.

slides.title: O‘tkir kompartment sindromi (ACS): ta’rif

bullets.text: ACS — jarohat yoki boshqa sabab qon ketish, shish yoki perfuziya buzilishini keltirib chiqargan klinik holat.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

bullets.text: Yopiq fastsial bo‘shliqda bosim oshadi, qon oqimi va to‘qima perfuziyasi kamayadi; ishemik og‘riq, to‘qima shikasti va oyoq-qo‘l xavfi paydo bo‘ladi.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

bullets.text: Bu jarrohlik shoshilinchligi; ko‘pincha boldir, bilak, son, oyoq kafti, dumba, qo‘l va qorinda uchraydi.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

bullets.text: Diqqat: ACS ko‘pincha crush sindromi bilan aralashtiriladi. Crush sindromi — tizimli holat, ACS — yopiq bo‘shliqdagi bosim holati.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama: 1) Fastsial bo‘shliq yopiq bo‘lishi bosimga qanday ta’sir qiladi? 2) ACS va crush sindromi farqi nimada? Doskada: yopiq qobiq ichida shish → bosim → perfuziya pasayishi sxemasi. Tipik xato: ACS va crush sindromini bir xil tushuncha deb yozish.

slides.title: Klinik belgilar: 5P mnemonikasi

bullets.text: 5P: nomutanosib og‘riq, oqarish, paresteziya, falaj va puls yo‘qligi.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

bullets.text: 5P ishonchsiz: belgilar ACS bo‘lmaganlarda ham uchraydi, ongi buzilgan bemorda foydasiz.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

bullets.text: Bu belgilar mushak nekrozini, ya’ni kech va qaytmas bosqichni bildiradi.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Eslab qoling: 5P — pain, pallor, paresteziya, paralysis, pulselessness. Muhokama: 1) Nega falaj va puls yo‘qligini kutish xavfli? 2) Ongi buzilgan bemorda ACS ni qanday gumon qilamiz? Doskada: 5P ni yozib, kech belgilarni (falaj, puls yo‘qligi) alohida belgilang. Tipik xato: 5P ni erta va ishonchli diagnostik mezon deb hisoblash.

slides.title: Klinik tekshiruvning cheklovlari

bullets.text: Kompartment sindromi 5P belgilari: nomutanosib og‘riq, oqarish, paresteziya, falaj, puls yo‘qligi. Ular ishonchli emas, ACS bo‘lmaganda ham uchraydi.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

bullets.text: Ongi pasaygan, hushsiz yoki sezgisiz bemorda 5P foydasiz. Diqqat: belgilar paydo bo‘lgan bo‘lsa, bu ko‘pincha mushak nekrozi, ya’ni kech va qaytmas bosqich.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

bullets.text: Ulmer ma’lumotiga ko‘ra klinik tekshiruvning sezgirligi past, manfiy bashoratli qiymati yuqori. Demak, u ACSni tasdiqlashdan ko‘ra inkor etishda yaxshiroq.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

bullets.text: Subyektiv baho standartlashtirilmaydi, tajribali shifokorda ham ishonchsiz. Natijada keraksiz keng fasciotomiya va yara infeksiyasi xavfi oshadi.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega 5P belgilari kech bosqichni ko‘rsatadi? 2) Sezgirligi past, lekin inkor qilish qobiliyati yaxshi test nimani anglatadi? Doskaga 5P ro‘yxatini yozdiring va har birining yonida kech belgi ekanini belgilatting. Tipik xato: 5P bo‘lmasa ACS yo‘q, deb xulosa qilish, yoki 5Pni erta belgi deb hisoblash.

slides.title: Kompartment bosimini o‘lchash usullari

bullets.text: Cadaver tizzalarida to‘g‘ri texnikada ham o‘lchovlarning 40% haqiqiy bosimdan 5 mmHg dan ortiq farq qilgan.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

bullets.text: Bosim kompartmentda bir tekis emas. Eng yuqori bosim sinish joyidan 5 sm ichida bo‘ladi, o‘lchash ham shu yerda tavsiya etilgan.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

bullets.text: Ofat hududlarida doimiy o‘lchash texnologiyasi chuqur to‘qimada sezgir emas va faqat tayyorlangan xodimga mos. Tashxis kechikadi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

columns.title: Xususiyati
items: Whitesides manometri: Invasiv igna bilan o‘lchash
STIC monitor: Portativ, yon teshikli igna, raqamli ekran

columns.title: Cheklov
items: Whitesides manometri: Mushak va qon laxtasi to‘sib qo‘yadi
Chok/fitil kateter: Mushak va laxta bilan to‘silib qoladi
STIC monitor: Joy, holat, igna uchi to‘qimasi ta’sir etadi

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 7 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega o‘lchash joyi natijani o‘zgartiradi? 2) Zilzila hududida qaysi usul real? Doskaga sinish joyi va undan 5 sm radiusni chizib, bosim qayerda yuqori ekanini ko‘rsatishni so‘rang. Tipik xato: bitta nuqtadagi bosimni butun kompartmentga xos deb hisoblash.

slides.title: Bosim chegaralari: mutlaq qiymat va ΔP

bullets.text: Mutlaq 30 mmHg chegarasi aniq emas: 30 mmHg dan yuqori bosim ham oqibatsiz chidalgan holatlar bor.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

bullets.text: Mutlaq qiymat o‘rniga ΔP qabul qilindi: diastolik bosimdan kompartment bosimi ayirmasi 30 mmHg dan kam bo‘lsa.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

bullets.text: Bitta o‘lchov faqat lahzalik perfuziyani aks ettiradi, shuning uchun vaqt omilini ham hisobga olish kerak.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 7 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega ΔP mutlaq qiymatdan afzal deb qabul qilindi? 2) ΔP asosida keraksiz operatsiyani qanday kamaytirish mumkin? Doskaga ΔP = diastolik bosim − kompartment bosimi formulasini yozdiring va misol uchun qiymat qo‘ydiring. Tipik xato: ΔP ni kompartment bosimining o‘zi bilan adashtirish yoki bosimni klinikadan ajratib baholash.

slides.title: Tezkor savol 3: Diqqat — bosim va diagnoz

bullets.text: Diqqat: yuqori bosim ≠ albatta ACS. Boldir diafizi sinishida yuqori bosim tez-tez uchraydi, lekin sindrom borligini bildirmaydi.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

bullets.text: Bosim sinish joyining 5 sm atrofida eng yuqori, shuning uchun o‘lchash nuqtasi natijaga ta’sir qiladi. Zona tashqarisida o‘lchash bo‘yicha yagona standart yo‘q.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

bullets.text: Bitta o‘lchov faqat shu daqiqadagi holatni ko‘rsatadi; vaqt omili ham hisobga olinadi, bir joydagi bosim butun qavatni aks ettirmasligi mumkin.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

bullets.text: Tezkor savol: nima uchun yagona va sinishdan uzoqda o‘lchangan bosimga ishonib bo‘lmaydi? Bosim qavat ichida bir tekis taqsimlanmagan.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega sinish yaqinida bosim yuqoriroq? 2) Bitta o‘lchov o‘rniga nima qilish mumkin? Doskada: boldir qavati va sinish chizig‘ini chizib, 5 sm zonani belgilang. Tipik xato: yuqori bosimni avtomatik ACS deb hisoblash.

slides.title: Voqea tahlili 3: noaniq klinika, yuqori bosim

bullets.text: Vaziyat: boldir sinishi bor bemorda klinik belgilar noaniq, kompartment bosimi esa yuqori. Fasciotomy (fastsiyani kesish) qilinsinmi?

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

bullets.text: Faqat bosimga tayanish xavfli. Bosim farqi (diastolik minus kompartment bosimi) 30 mm Hg dan past mezonida bemorlarning 45,4% i keraksiz operatsiyaga tushardi.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

bullets.text: Sinishda yuqori bosim ko‘pincha sindromga teng emas. Ortiqcha fasciotomy yara infeksiyasi va boshqa asoratlar xavfini oshiradi.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

bullets.text: Yana nimani hisobga olish kerak: ortib borayotgan og‘riq, bosimning vaqt bo‘yicha o‘zgarishi, shikast mexanizmi va teridagi pufakchalar.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 7 daq. Muhokama: 1) Faqat bosimga tayanish qanday xatolarga olib keladi? 2) Bosim noaniq bo‘lsa, qaysi klinik va mexanizm belgilariga qaraysiz? Doskada: qaror daraxti — klinika, bosim, vaqt, mexanizm. Tipik xato: bosim raqamini yagona mezon deb olish.

slides.title: Shikast mexanizmi bo‘yicha tasnif

bullets.text: Siqilish sindromi uzoq davom etgan bosimdan kelib chiqadi: oyoq-qo‘l shishadi, shok, mioglobinuriya va buyrak yetishmovchiligi rivojlanadi.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

bullets.text: Diqqat: siqilish sindromi ≠ Volkmann kontrakturasi; ikkinchisi o‘tkazib yuborilgan tomir shikastining kech holati.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

bullets.text: Sinish ACS ning asosiy omili (taxminan 75%); bunda qavat ichi tuzilishi buzilmagan bo‘ladi.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega har bir mexanizmda taktika farq qiladi? 2) Siqilish sindromi va Volkmann kontrakturasi qanday farqlanadi? Doskada: uch ustunli jadvalni talabalar bilan to‘ldiring. Tipik xato: siqilish sindromi va Volkmann kontrakturasini bir tushuncha deb olish.

slides.title: Sinish pufakchalari: bosimni bo‘shatish belgisi

bullets.text: Sinishga bog‘liq o‘tkir kompartment sindromida (ACS) kompartment ichidagi tuzilma, siqilish jarohatidan farqli, aslida buzilmagan bo‘ladi.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

bullets.text: Siqilishda hujayra nobud bo‘lib, tarkibi to‘qima oralig‘iga chiqadi. Suyuqlik to‘planib, ichki bosim yanada ortadi.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

bullets.text: Sinishda bosim butun fastsiya atrofidagi mexanizmlar orqali chiqishi mumkin. Boldirda suyuqlik yoki qon to‘lgan pufakchalar 6 soatdan keyin ko‘rinadi.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

bullets.text: Diqqat: pufakcha bosimni bo‘shatadi degani mualliflar farazi. Laboratoriya dalili yetarli emas, tekshiruv rejalashtirilgan.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega sinishda va siqilishda bosim ortishi mexanizmi farq qiladi? 2) Pufakchani qanday talqin qilish mumkin? Doskada: ikki ustunli sxema chizing, “Sinish: fastsiya butun, hujayra o‘limi kam” va “Siqilish: hujayra o‘limi, osmotik suyuqlik”. Tipik xato: pufakchani isbotlangan xavfsizlik belgisi deb o‘ylash.

slides.title: Voqea tahlili 4: sinish yoki siqilish?

bullets.text: Vaziyat A: boldir suyagi sinishi, terida suyuqlik yoki qon to‘lgan pufakchalar bor. Vaziyat B: qulagan konstruksiya ostida uzoq qolgan oyoq.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

bullets.text: Savol: qaysi birida fasciotomiya (fastsiyani kesib bosimni tushirish) ehtiyotkorlik bilan tanlanadi va nega?

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

bullets.text: Sinishda ortiqcha davolashdan qochish uchun qo‘shimcha tekshiruv kerak, ayniqsa pufakcha bo‘lsa. Fasciotomiya ko‘rsatmasi qat’iy nazoratda bo‘lishi lozim.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

bullets.text: Fasciotomiya yopiq jarohatni ochiqqa aylantirib, infeksiyani oshiradi. Ochiq jarohat yoki qon aylanishi pasayishi bo‘lmasa, konservativ yo‘l tavsiya etilgan.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 7 daq. Muhokama: 1) Ikkala vaziyatda ehtiyotkorlik sabablari qanday farq qiladi? 2) Qaysi holatda fasciotomiyaga ko‘rsatma qat’iy bo‘ladi? Doskada: A va B uchun “mexanizm – xavf – qaror” uch qatorli jadval chizing. Tipik xato: fasciotomiyani siqilishda ham har doim majburiy deb hisoblash. Aniq javob: mexanizmni aniqlash qarorning asosi.

slides.title: Fasciotomiya vaqti va natijalar

bullets.text: Mushak nekrozi 3 soatdan boshlanib, 8 soatda doimiy bo‘lishi mumkin; nerv uchun 4 va 12 soat muhim.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

bullets.text: 12 soat ichida davolangan 22 bemorning 68 foizi, keyin davolanganlarning 8 foizi tiklandi.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

bullets.text: Bolalar bosimga uzoqroq chidaydi; aniq vaqtni belgilash qiyin, xavf va foyda tortiladi.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

items.title: 3 soat
items.text: Mushak nekrozi ko‘rina boshlaydi — 8 soatda doimiy bo‘lishi mumkin

items.title: 4 soat
items.text: Nerv o‘tkazuvchanligi tiklanadi — Bosim miqdoridan qat’i nazar

items.title: 12 soat
items.text: Nerv o‘tkazuvchanligi tiklanmaydi — 12 soat ichida 68%, keyin 8% tiklangan

items.title: Bolalar
items.text: Bosimga chidamlilik yuqoriroq — 24 soatda ham tiklanish mumkin

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 8 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega aniq soat belgilash qiyin? 2) Nega kechikkan fasciotomiya ba’zan zararli bo‘ladi? Doskada: 0–12 soatlik vaqt chizig‘ini chizib, 3, 4, 8 va 12 soatni belgilang. Tipik xato: bu raqamlarni qat’iy chegara deb qabul qilish; manbada tadqiqotlar natijalari bir-biridan farq qiladi.

slides.title: Fasciotomiya bahsi: foyda va xavf

bullets.text: Erta fasciotomiya mushakning keyingi shikastlanishini oldini olishi mumkin; ba’zi mualliflar uni tavsiya qiladi.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

bullets.text: Fasciotomiya yopiq jarohatni ochiq qiladi: infeksiya, sepsis va amputatsiya xavfi oshadi.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

bullets.text: Oyoq periferik pulslari paypaslanmasa, jarrohlik dekompressiyasi zarur; bunda bahs yo‘q.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

columns.title: Foyda
items: Vaqt: Erta qilinsa mushak shikasti kamayadi
Asorat: Oyoq va funksiya saqlanishi mumkin

columns.title: Xavf
items: Jarohat: Yopiq jarohat ochiq bo‘lib qoladi

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6-7 daqiqa. Muhokama: 1) Nega ezilish sindromida fasciotomiya bahsli, sinish bilan bog‘liq ACSda esa boshqacha? 2) Qaysi holatda dekompressiya shubhasiz zarur? Doskaga chizing: ikki ustunli «foyda — xavf» jadvali va pulssiz oyoq uchun alohida strelka. Tipik xato: fasciotomiyani ezilish sindromida har doim foydali deb o‘ylash. Manbada natijani yaxshilashi aniq isbotlanmagan, kechiktirilgani esa yomon oqibat bilan bog‘langan. Ezilish jarohatida ayrim mualliflar fasciotomiya emas, erta debridman tavsiya qiladi.

slides.title: Dastlabki davolash: suyuqlik terapiyasi

bullets.text: Vena ichiga suyuqlik ozod qilishdan oldin boshlanadi; tarkibida kaliy bo‘lgan eritmalardan qochiladi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Maqsad: kattalarda siydik kamida 300 ml/soat, kamida dastlabki 24 soat davomida.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Natriy bikarbonat va mannitol faqat ko‘rsatma bo‘lsa beriladi; ular tasodifiy sinovda faqat suyuqlik bilan solishtirilmagan.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daqiqa. Muhokama: 1) Nega ozod qilishdan oldin suyuqlik boshlash muhim (ishemiya-reperfuziya)? 2) Nega kaliyli eritmalardan qochiladi? Doskaga chizing: suyuqlik, siydik hajmi va 24 soat zanjiri. Tipik xato: bikarbonat va mannitolni hamma bemorga majburiy berish. Manbada ular faqat asidoz tuzatish yoki siydik hajmini saqlash uchun zarur bo‘lganda tavsiya etilgan.

slides.title: Davolashdagi vaqt va hajm ko‘rsatkichlari

bullets.text: Skelet mushagi 2-4 soat ishemiyaga chidaydi deb hisoblangan, ammo qaytmas o‘zgarishlar 1 soatdayoq boshlanishi mumkin.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Suyuqlik iloji boricha 6 soat ichida boshlanadi; kattalarda siydik chiqarishi kamida 300 ml/soat bo‘lishi, kamida dastlabki 24 soat davom etishi kerak.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Natriy bikarbonat faqat atsidozni tuzatish uchun, mannitol faqat siydik 300 ml/soat dan kam bo‘lganda qo‘llanadi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Oyoq kafti suyaklari sinishining 0,7% ida fasciotomiya bajariladi; ochiq sinish, ezilish shikasti va ko‘p sinish asosiy bashoratchilar.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 3 daqiqa. Muhokama: nega suyuqlik ozod qilishdan oldin boshlanadi? Doskada: raqamlar ro‘yxati. Tipik xato: 2-4 soatni xavfsiz muddat deb o‘ylash.

slides.title: Mannitol-bikarbonat kokteyli va qo‘shimcha usullar

bullets.text: Mannitol-bikarbonat kokteyli: 1000 ml 0,45% NaCl va 5% dekstrozaga 40 mEq NaHCO3 va 50 ml 20% mannitol aralashtiriladi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Bunday kokteyl bilan tez suyuqlik terapiyasi ofatlardagi CS da o‘tkir buyrak yetishmovchiligini oldini olishda samarali topilgan.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Hozircha bikarbonat yoki mannitol bilan suyuqlik terapiyasini faqat suyuqlik terapiyasi bilan solishtirgan randomizatsiyalangan sinov yo‘q.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Muz terapiyasi mitoxondriya disfunksiyasi va yallig‘lanishni kamaytiradi; giperbarik kislorod esa fasciotomiyagacha progressiyani to‘xtatadigan yagona usul.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 4 daqiqa. Muhokama: nega dalillar yetarli bo‘lmasa ham koktayl tilga olinadi? Doskada: uch ustun. Tipik xato: koktaylni isbotlangan standart deb hisoblash; randomizatsiyalangan sinov yo‘q.
slides.diagram_note: Kokteyl samaradorligi randomizatsiyalangan sinovlarda tasdiqlanmagan; muz va giperbarik kislorod qo‘shimcha usul sifatida keltirilgan.

slides.title: Og‘ir ezilish jarohatida to‘qimani tiklash

bullets.text: Og‘ir ezilish jarohatini davolashning maqsadi — jonsiz to‘qimani olib tashlash (debridman) va bo‘shliqni qon tomirli to‘qima bilan to‘ldirish.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Yumshoq to‘qimani yopishda eng yaxshi usullar sifatida yonbosh, yelkaning yog‘-fassiya lateral va nozik mushak (gracilis) bo‘laklari keltirilgan.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Hamroh suyak nuqsonlari erkin kortikoperiostal bo‘lak bilan yaxshi tiklanadi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Barmoq nuqsonlarida amputatsiyadan qochish va qo‘l funksiyasini tiklash uchun to‘liq yoki qisman oyoq barmog‘ini ko‘chirish talab etiladi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 3 daqiqa. Muhokama: nega minimal teri shikastli ezilish jarohatini davolash qiyin? Doskada: daraxt. Tipik xato: barcha holatda amputatsiya zarur deb hisoblash.

slides.title: Turniket va amputatsiya qarori

bullets.text: Og‘ir ezilish jarohatida prehospital turniket kuchli tavsiya etiladi, ammo bu masala hali bahsli.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Amputatsiya odatda quyidagi uch guruhdan kamida ikkitasida omil bo‘lganda qilinadi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: MESS (Mangled Extremity Severity Score) yordam beradi; u asosan pastki oyoq jarohatiga tayangan.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

children.label: Oyoq xususiyati
items: Keng birga kelgan shikast; uzoq ishemiya

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6-7 daqiqa. Muhokama: 1) Nima uchun bitta omil amputatsiyaga yetarli emas? 2) Nega shkalalar yuqori oyoqda ishonchsiz? Doskaga chizing: uch guruh va «≥2» qoidasi. Tipik xato: turniketni ezilish sindromining oldini oluvchi umumiy usul deb o‘ylash. Manbada ozod qilishdan oldin keng tavsiya etilmaydi, lekin og‘ir jarohatda prehospital qo‘llash kuchli tavsiya etiladi va masala bahsli. MESS bilan Mangled Extremity Syndrome Index ni aralashtirmang.

slides.title: Tezkor savol 4: davolash taktikasi

bullets.text: Suyuqlik: vena ichiga imkon qadar erta (ideal 6 soat ichida), ajratishdan oldin ham boshlanadi. Kaliyli eritmadan qoching; kattalarda diurez kamida 300 ml/soat.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Turniket ezilishda hali bahsli. Fasciotomiya foydasi aniq isbotlanmagan, lekin oyoqda tomir urishi paypaslanmasa, jarrohlik dekompressiya shart.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Amputatsiya: gemodinamika nazoratsiz, oyoq jarohati keng yoki ishemiya uzoq bo‘lsa o‘ylanadi. Odatda kamida ikki guruh omili birga bo‘ladi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Savol: kattalarda infuziya paytida minimal diurez qancha bo‘lishi kerak va kamida necha soat davom ettiriladi?

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Javob: kamida 300 mL/soat, kamida dastlabki 24 soat. Muhokama: 1) nega suyuqlik ajratib olishdan oldin boshlanadi? 2) turniket va fasciotomiya nega bahsli? Doskada: davolash bosqichlari zanjirini chizdiring (voqea joyi → suyuqlik → asoratlar → jarrohlik). Tipik xato: kaliyli eritma tanlash yoki fasciotomiyani har doim majburiy deb o‘ylash.

slides.title: Asoratlar va prognoz

bullets.text: Mushak zarari uch vaqtda bo‘ladi: ezilish paytida, ishemiya davrida va reperfuziya vaqtida.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Giperkaliemiya va o‘tkir buyrak yetishmovchiligi (ARF) xavfli; buyrak almashtirish terapiyasi bo‘lsa, ARF natijasi yaxshi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: O‘tkazib yuborilgan kompartment sindromi shifokorlarga qarshi da’volarning eng ko‘p sabablaridan biri.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) nega ARF bashoratchilari orasida qamalish vaqti bor? 2) sud-tibbiy ekspertizada o‘tkazib yuborilgan kompartment sindromi qanday ahamiyatga ega? Doskada: ezilish → ishemiya → reperfuziya → asoratlar sxemasini chizdiring. Tipik xato: AKI (o‘tkir buyrak shikastlanishi) va ARF ni butunlay boshqa holat deb o‘ylash; manbada o‘lim sababi sifatida AKI yetakchi deyilgan.

slides.title: Haqiqiy ofatlardan tajriba: Kobe, Bam, Haiti

bullets.text: Kobe modeli dala va kasalxonada baholab, og‘ir CS xavfi yuqori qurbonlarni ajratishga yordam beradi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Bam: ARF bilan bemorlar uzoq qamalgan; erta ajratib olish va tez gospitalizatsiya hal qiluvchi bo‘ldi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Haitida buyrak yetishmovchiligi bor bemorlarning yarmidan ko‘pi buyrak almashtirish terapiyasiga muhtoj bo‘lgan.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

items.title: 1995, Kobe
items.text: 372 ta ezilish bemori — Ikki bosqichli triaj modeli

items.title: 2003, Bam
items.text: 2086 ta bemor (10 kun) — Uzoq qamalish — ARF ko‘proq

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Kobe triaj modelini cheklangan resurslarda qanday qo‘llash mumkin? 2) Haitida ARF ulushi nega 0,5–25% oralig‘ida o‘zgargan (zilzila kuchi, vayronada qolish vaqti)? Doskada: uch ofat uchun qamalish vaqti → ARF → o‘lim bog‘liqligini chizing. Tipik xato: 25% ni ARF ulushi deb o‘ylash; u CS ko‘rgan qurbonlar ulushi, CS-ARF esa 0,5–25%.

slides.title: Voqea tahlili 5: ommaviy zilzila jabrlanuvchilari

bullets.text: Vaziyat: Bam (Eron, 2003) zilzilasidan keyingi dastlabki 10 kunda jarohat bilan yotqizilgan 2 086 bemorning ma‘lumotlar bazasi tahlil qilingan.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Buyrak o‘tkir yetishmovchiligi (ARF) rivojlangan bemorlar vayrona ostida uzoqroq qolgan, kechroq va uzoqroq yotqizilgan. Ularda asorat va o‘lim ko‘proq bo‘lgan.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: ARF xavfini oshiradigan omillar: vayronada qolgan vaqt, bir nechta ezilish shikasti, erkak jinsi, infeksiya va kreatinkinaza darajasi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Savol: erta ozod qilish va triaj nega muhim? Kobe (1995) tajribasida 372 bemor asosida tuzilgan modellar yuqori xavfli jabrlanuvchini ajratishga yordam bergan.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6–7 daq. Muhokama: 1) Resurs cheklangan bo‘lsa, ozod qilish va yotqizish tartibini nima belgilaydi? 2) Vayrona ostida qolish vaqti sud-tibbiy ekspertizada o‘lim sababini baholashga qanday ta‘sir qiladi? Doskada chizish: ‘vayrona ostida qolish vaqti → ARF → o‘lim’ zanjirini va uning yoniga xavf omillarini chizing. Tipik xato: talabalar triajni faqat tashqi jarohat og‘irligiga qarab o‘tkazadi, vaholanki ezilish sindromi dastlab yashirin bo‘lishi mumkin.

slides.title: Kelajak yo‘nalishlari: diagnostika va yangi davolar

bullets.text: Yangi diagnostika g‘oyalari: yallig‘lanish mediatorlari marker sifatida, ultrafiltratsiya kateteri, yaqin infraqizil spektroskopiya, radiochastotali implantlar.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Hayvon modellarida (asosan kalamush) yallig‘lanishga va oksidlanishga qarshi dorilar, ruh xelatorlari, natriy nitrit, deksametazon, anizodamin sinalgan.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Bu davolar klinikada yetarlicha o‘rganilmagan, xavfsizligi tekshirilishi kerak. Maqsad — ularni jabrlanuvchini ozod qilishdan oldin yoki paytida qo‘llash.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Ofat tibbiyoti standartlari: JSST va Xalqaro Qizil Xoch qo‘mitasi shoshilinch tibbiy guruhlar (EMT) tasnifi va jarohat yo‘riqnomasini tuzgan. Yagona triaj yo‘q.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5–6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Hayvon modelida samarali dori nega odamda darhol qo‘llanmaydi? 2) Yangi diagnostik usullar bugungi qaysi kamchilikni to‘ldirishi kerak? Doskada chizish: ‘hayvon modeli → klinik tadqiqot → dala sharoitida qo‘llash’ yo‘lini chizing. Tipik xato: kalamush modelidagi natijani odamda isbotlangan davo deb hisoblash.

slides.title: Xulosa va asosiy xulosalar

bullets.text: Ezilish shikasti (CI) — to‘qima jarohati; tizimli belgilar qo‘shilsa, ezilish sindromi (CS). Asosiy mexanizm: uzoq ishemiya va reperfuziya jarohati.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: Davolashni zudlik bilan boshlash ofatdagi CS o‘limini kamaytiradigan eng muhim omil. Suyuqlik berish imkon bo‘lsa, ozod qilishdan oldin boshlanadi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

bullets.text: O‘tkir kompartment sindromi (ACS) tashxisida 5P belgilari ishonchsiz, bosim chegarasi bahsli. Klinika va bosimni birga olganda ham yagona standart mezon yo‘q.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

bullets.text: Shikast mexanizmini tasniflash (yumshoq to‘qima, tomir, suyak sinishi) davoni belgilaydi. Ezilishda fasciotomiya o‘rni bahsli, erta debridman ko‘rib chiqiladi.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama: 1) CI va CS farqini o‘z so‘zingiz bilan ayting. 2) ACS tashxisida nima uchun bitta belgi yoki bitta bosim ko‘rsatkichiga tayanib bo‘lmaydi? Doskada chizish: mavzu bo‘yicha ‘CI → ishemiya → reperfuziya → CS → asoratlar’ umumiy zanjirini chizing. Tipik xato: bosim farqi chegarasi manbalarda turlicha berilgan (Usuda: <20 mm Hg, Guo: <30 mm Hg) — bitta raqamni mutlaq deb o‘rgatmang; CI ≠ CS ekanini ta‘kidlang.

mcq.question: Zilzilada vayron bo‘lgan binodan chiqarilgan bemorda oyoqda faqat mahalliy to‘qima shikasti bor, tizimli belgilar yo‘q. Bu holatga qaysi atama mos keladi?
options: Siqilish sindromi (crush syndrome, CS) – tizimli belgilar bilan
Siqilish shikasti (crush injury, CI) – mahalliy to‘qima shikasti
Ishemiya-reperfuziya sindromi – umumiy yallig‘lanish bilan
Rabdomiolizdan kelib chiqqan o‘tkir buyrak yetishmovchiligi
mcq.explanation: Manbaga ko‘ra «siqilish shikasti» to‘qima shikastini bildiradi. «Siqilish sindromi» esa tizimli belgilar bilan kechadigan siqilish shikastlari uchun ishlatiladi. Bemorda tizimli belgilar yo‘q, shuning uchun CI to‘g‘ri atama.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

mcq.question: Patolog London bombardimonida bir necha soat ko‘milib qolganlar otopsiyasida mushak nekrozi bilan buyrak kanalchalaridagi qo‘ng‘ir pigment bog‘liqligini aniqladi. Bu qaysi tarixiy tavsifga mos?
options: Messina zilzilasi kuzatuvlari, 1901-yil
Kobe zilzilasi tahlili, 1995-yil
Bywaters va hamkasblari tavsifi, 1941-yil
Bam zilzilasi tadqiqoti, 2003-yil
mcq.explanation: Bywaters va hamkasblari 1941-yilda London bombardimonlari qurbonlarida mushak nekrozi va buyrak kanalchalaridagi qo‘ng‘ir pigment o‘rtasidagi bog‘liqlikni tasvirlagan. Sindrom birinchi marta 1901-yilgi Messina zilzilasida kuzatilgan, ammo bu pigment bog‘liqligining tavsifi emas.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

mcq.question: Zilzilaning sud-tibbiy tahlilida ekspert sistematik sharhga tayanib, omon qolganlar orasida siqilish sindromining uchrash chastotasini baholamoqchi. Qaysi ko‘rsatkich to‘g‘ri?
options: Taxminan 2–15 foiz oralig‘ida
Taxminan 48 foiz atrofida
Taxminan 10,6 foiz atrofida
Taxminan 0,5–25 foiz oralig‘ida
mcq.explanation: Sistematik sharhga ko‘ra zilzila omon qolganlarida CS uchrashi 2–15 foiz. 48 foiz — o‘lim ko‘rsatkichining yuqori chegarasi, 10,6 foiz — travmatik yurak to‘xtashidagi tirik qolish, 0,5–25 foiz — Gaitidagi CS bilan bog‘liq o‘tkir buyrak yetishmovchiligi uchrashi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

mcq.question: Yuqori energiyali avtohalokatdan keyin chanoq halqasi uzilgan, chanoq qon tomirlari shikastlangan bemorda yuqori o‘limning asosiy sababi nima?
options: Buyrak kanalchalarida miyoglobin to‘planishi
Yuqori ko‘krakdagi traxeyaning uzilishi
Ichak tutqichining (mezenteriya) yirtilishi
Chanoqdan qon ketishi sababli shok
mcq.explanation: Chanoq qon tomir shikastlari odatda yuqori energiyali travmadan bo‘ladi, chanoq halqasi uzilishi bilan birga keladi. Yuqori o‘lim chanoqdagi qon ketishidan kelib chiqqan shok bilan bog‘liq. Erta ko‘p qatlamli kompyuter tomografiyasi (CT) va tezkor davo holatni o‘zgartirishi mumkin.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

mcq.question: Og‘ir qorin siqilish shikastida ichak tutqichining (mezenteriya) yirtilishi qaysi xavfli holatga olib kelishi mumkin?
options: Faqat teri osti gematomasi paydo bo‘lishi
Yuqori nafas yo‘lining traxeya uzilishi
Gemorragik shok va ko‘p a’zo yetishmovchiligi
Faqat mushak kompartment sindromi rivojlanishi
mcq.explanation: Manbada mezenterial yirtilish kuchli qon ketishga, bu esa gemorragik shok va ko‘p a’zo yetishmovchiligiga olib kelishi mumkinligi aytilgan. Traxeya uzilishi esa yuqori ko‘krak siqilish shikastlariga xos.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

mcq.question: Zilziladan keyin qulagan bino ostida bir necha soat qolgan, oyog‘i ezilgan shaxs hali ozod qilinmagan. Birinchi navbatda qaysi tadbir tavsiya etiladi?
options: Ozod qilishdan oldin kaliysiz eritmani venaga yuborish
Infuziyani kasalxonaga yetkazilgandan keyin boshlash
Ozod qilingach kaliyli eritma bilan infuziya boshlash
Suyuqlik yuborishni ozod etilgach bir sutkaga kechiktirish
mcq.explanation: Ezilish sindromida erta suyuqlik berish muhim. Uni ozod qilishdan oldin boshlash va kaliyli eritmalardan qochish tavsiya etiladi. Ozod qilingach giperkaliemiya xavfi ortadi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

mcq.question: Mushak bo‘limida shish va qon ketishi tufayli to‘qima suyuqligi bosimi mushak va nerv kapillyar perfuziya bosimidan oshdi. Bu qanday oqibatga olib keladi?
options: Qon oqimi kuchayib, mushak to‘qimasi tezda to‘liq tiklanadi
To‘qimalar ishemiyaga uchrab, kompartment sindromi belgilari boshlanadi
Faqat teri ustki qatlami shikastlanadi, mushak esa sog‘lom qoladi
Suyuqlik bosimi o‘z-o‘zidan pasayib, perfuziya yaxshilanadi
mcq.explanation: Fassial qobiq ichida bosim perfuziya bosimidan oshsa, mushak va nerv to‘qimalari ishemik bo‘ladi. Skelet mushagi kompartment sindromining belgilari paydo bo‘ladi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

mcq.question: Uzoq ezilgan oyoq ozod qilindi va ishemik mushakka qon qayta oqdi. Mushak shikastini kuchaytiruvchi, birinchi kiradigan hujayralar qaysi?
options: Limfotsitlar — ular birinchi bo‘lib mushakka kiradi
Trombotsitlar — ular birinchi bo‘lib mushakka kiradi
Neytrofillar — ular birinchi bo‘lib mushakka kiradi
Eritrotsitlar — ular birinchi bo‘lib mushakka kiradi
mcq.explanation: Ishemik mushakka qon qayta kirganda darhol yallig‘lanish javobi boshlanadi. Neytrofillar birinchi infiltratsiya qilib, mushak shikastini kuchaytiradi (ishemiya-reperfuziya shikasti).

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

mcq.question: Ezilish sindromi bemorida shikastlangan mushakdan ko‘p mioglobin qonga chiqdi. Buyrak kanalchalarida nima yuz beradi?
options: Mioglobin kanalchalar hujayralarini himoya qilib, ishini yaxshilaydi
Mioglobin faqat qon tomirida qolib, buyrak kanalchalariga o‘tmaydi
Mioglobin buyrak koptokchalarida qon ivishini to‘xtatib qo‘yadi
Mioglobin kanalchalarda to‘planib, temir va oksidlovchi stress bilan buzadi
mcq.explanation: Shikastlangan mushakdan ajralgan mioglobin buyrak kanalchalarida to‘planib, ularning ishini buzadi. Temir miqdorining oshishi va oksidlovchi stress kanalchalarni to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri zararlaydi. Bu o‘tkir buyrak shikasti (AKI) asosidir.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

mcq.question: Boldir sinishidan keyin bemorda pulsizlik va falaj aniqlandi. Manbaga ko‘ra, 5P belgilarining bu qismi odatda nimani bildiradi?
options: ACS ning eng erta va osonlik bilan qaytadigan bosqichi
Mushak nekrozini bildiruvchi eng og‘ir, qaytmas bosqich
Faqat nerv qisilishini bildiruvchi, mushak sog‘lom bosqich
Bemor bezovtaligidan kelib chiqqan yolg‘on, ahamiyatsiz belgilar
mcq.explanation: 5P (og‘riq, oqarish, paresteziya, falaj, pulsizlik) ishonchsiz mezon. Bu belgilar paydo bo‘lishi odatda mushak nekrozini va ACS ning eng og‘ir, qaytmas bosqichini bildiradi.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

mcq.question: Hushsiz holatdagi bemorda 5P belgilariga tayanishning asosiy cheklovi qaysi?
options: Bu belgilar faqat bolalarda uchraydi, kattalarda uchramaydi
Barcha 5P belgilari bosim o‘lchagich bilan to‘liq almashtiriladi
Bemor og‘riq va sezgi haqida fikr-mulohaza bera olmaydi
Bu belgilar kasallikning juda erta bosqichida yo‘qolib ketadi
mcq.explanation: 5P belgilari (og‘riq, rangsizlik, parestezi, falaj, pulssizlik) hushsiz yoki sezgisiz bemorlarda foydasiz, chunki ular fikr-mulohaza bera olmaydi. Bu belgilar ko‘pincha kechki, qaytmas bosqichni bildiradi. Ular arterial ishemiya belgisi ham bo‘lishi mumkin. Shuning uchun klinik tekshiruv ACS ni tasdiqlashdan ko‘ra istisno qilishda yaxshiroq.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

mcq.question: Whitesides igna manometri va fitil (wick) kateteri kabi invaziv qurilmalarning asosiy kamchiligi nima?
options: Mushak bo‘lakchalari va qon laxtalari bilan tiqilib qolishi
Faqat hushyor bemorlarda ishlashi va bolalarda qo‘llanmasligi
Bosimni faqat teri yuzasidan, ignasiz o‘lchashga asoslanishi
Natijani faqat bir necha kundan keyin berishi va qimmatligi
mcq.explanation: Manbada Whitesides igna manometri, slit va wick kateterlarining kamchiligi shundaki, ular mushak bo‘laklari va qon laxtalari bilan osongina tiqilib qoladi. O‘lchash natijasiga bemor holati, o‘lchash joyi va igna uchidagi to‘qima ham ta’sir qiladi. Boshqa variantlar manbada keltirilmagan.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

mcq.question: Boldir diafizi sinishi bor bemorda klinika noaniq, bitta o‘lchovda kompartment bosimi yuqori chiqdi. Qaysi xulosa to‘g‘ri?
options: Yuqori bosim har doim ACS ni isbotlaydi, darhol operatsiya shart
Bosim ko‘rsatkichi diagnozda umuman e’tiborga olinmasligi kerak
Bosim tushguncha kuzatuvsiz fasciotomiyani kechiktirish zarur
Yuqori bosim o‘zi ACS emas; vaqt omili va klinika ham hisobga olinadi
mcq.explanation: Boldir diafizi sinishida yuqori bosim ko‘pincha uchraydi, lekin u ko‘p hollarda ACS borligini bildirmaydi. Bitta o‘lchov faqat lahzalik perfuziyani aks ettiradi. Shuning uchun diagnozda vaqt omili, klinik ko‘rinish va bosim birga baholanadi. Bosim o‘lchash noaniq klinikada tasdiqlash yoki istisno qilish uchun foydali.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

mcq.question: Sheridan va Matsen kuzatuvida 12 soat ichida davolangan 22 bemorning necha foizida oyoq funksiyasi tiklandi?
mcq.explanation: Sheridan va Matsen: 12 soat ichida davolanganlarning 68 foizida pastki oyoq funksiyasi normallashgan, 12 soatdan keyin davolanganlarda esa atigi 8 foizda. 20% va 90% qiymatlari Labbe bo‘yicha ishemiya 3 va 5 soat bo‘lgandagi mushak nekrozi darajasiga tegishli.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

mcq.question: Boldir sinishi bor bemorda 6 soatdan keyin sinish joyida tiniq suyuqlikli pufakcha paydo bo‘ldi. Qaysi yondashuv to‘g‘ri?
options: Pufakcha ko‘ringanidan so‘ng darhol fasciotomiya qilish shart
Pufakchani oddiy teri infeksiyasi deb hisoblab, bosimni e’tiborsiz qoldirish
Pufakchani bosim bo‘shalishi belgisi deb hisoblab, fasciotomiya zaruratini ehtiyotkor baholash
Sinish holatida ACS bo‘lmaydi, shuning uchun kuzatuvni to‘xtatish
mcq.explanation: Mualliflar farazi: sinish pufakchasi kompartmentdagi g‘ayritabiiy yuqori bosimni bo‘shatish mexanizmi bo‘lishi mumkin. Sinishda kompartment tuzilmasi buzilmaydi, siqilishdan farqli ravishda hujayra nobud bo‘lishi kam uchraydi. Shuning uchun sinish bilan bog‘liq holatlarda fasciotomiya zarurati ehtiyotkorlik bilan baholanishi kerak. Faraz laboratoriya natijalari bilan hali yetarli tasdiqlanmagan.

source.author: Guo et al.
source.title: Acute compartment syndrome, Medicine

mcq.question: Ezilgan oyoqda periferik pulslar paypaslanmayapti. Bu holatda qanday davo choraси zarur deb hisoblanadi?
options: Faqat muz bilan davolash va kuzatish
Jarrohlik yo‘li bilan dekompressiya qilish
Faqat natriy bikarbonat yuborish
Faqat gipербарik kislorodni qo‘llash
mcq.explanation: Fasciotomiya ezilish sindromida bahsli. Biroq oyoq-qo‘l pulslari paypaslanmasa, jarrohlik dekompressiyasi zarurligi haqida munozara yo‘q. Muz, bikarbonat va gipербарik kislorod bu holatda jarrohlik o‘rnini bosmaydi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

mcq.question: Qutqaruvchilar vayrona ostidagi jabrlanuvchini hali chiqarmagan. Suyuqlik terapiyasi bo‘yicha qaysi harakat tavsiya etiladi?
options: Kaliy saqlovchi eritma bilan infuziyani boshlash
Suyuqlikni faqat kasalxonada boshlash
Siydik chiqishini ataylab kamaytirish
Venaga suyuqlikni ajratib olishdan oldin boshlash
mcq.explanation: Erta va faol suyuqlik berish, ideal holda jabrlanuvchi ajratib olinishidan oldin boshlanadi. Kaliy saqlovchi eritmalardan qochish kerak, chunki giperkaliemiya xavfi bor.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

mcq.question: Oyoq-qo‘lni saqlab qolish va amputatsiya o‘rtasida tanlashda amputatsiya odatda qachon amalga oshiriladi?
options: Kamida ikkita kichik guruh omillari mavjud bo‘lganda
Faqat bitta kichik guruh omili aniqlanganda
Faqat jarohat mexanizmi asosida qaror qilinganda
Uchala guruh omillari to‘liq bo‘lgandagina
mcq.explanation: Omillar uch guruhga bo‘linadi: umumiy bemor omillari, oyoq-qo‘lga xos omillar va jarohat mexanizmi omillari. Amputatsiya odatda kamida ikki guruh omillari bo‘lganda amalga oshiriladi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

mcq.question: Ezilish jabrlanuvchisiga yetarli suyuqlik berilmoqda, lekin diurez soatiga 300 mL dan past. Qaysi chora qo‘shiladi?
options: Infuziyani to‘xtatib, kuzatuvga o‘tish
Kaliy saqlovchi eritmani qo‘shib yuborish
Natriy bikarbonatni majburiy berishni boshlash
Mannitolni siydik hajmini ushlash uchun qo‘shish
mcq.explanation: Mannitol faqat yetarli suyuqlikka qaramay kattalarda siydik chiqishini kamida 300 mL/soat ushlab turish uchun beriladi. Bikarbonat esa faqat tizimli atsidozni to‘g‘rilash zarur bo‘lganda qo‘llanadi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

mcq.question: Bam zilzilasi tajribasiga ko‘ra, o‘tkir buyrak yetishmovchiligi (OBY) va o‘limni oldini olishda nima hal qiluvchi bo‘ldi?
options: Erta ajratib olish va tez kasalxonaga yotqizish
Bemorlarni imkon qadar kechroq yotqizish
Kech bo‘lsa ham jarrohlik amaliyotlarini ko‘paytirish
Yordamni faqat yosh bemorlar bilan cheklash
mcq.explanation: Bam tahlilida OBY bo‘lgan bemorlar uzoqroq qamalib qolgan, kechroq yotqizilgan va ko‘proq asoratga uchragan. Erta ajratib olish va tez ko‘p tarmoqli yordam hal qiluvchi bo‘ldi.

source.author: Usuda et al.
source.title: Crush syndrome: a review for prehospital providers and emergency clinicians, Journal of Translational Medicine

extras.text: Tarixiy fakt: Bywaters va hamkasblari 1941-yilda London bombardimonida bir necha soat vayrona ostida qolganlar o‘limidan keyin buyrak kanalchalarida qo‘ng‘ir pigment topdi. Ular uni mushak nekrozi bilan bog‘ladi. Bu sud-tibbiy yorishda ham muhim kuzatuv. Sindrom ilk bor 1901-yilgi Messina zilzilasida kuzatilgan.

extras.text: Eslab qolish usuli: “Jarohat – to‘qima, sindrom – butun tana”. Crush injury (CI) faqat to‘qima shikastini bildiradi. Crush syndrome (CS) esa ezilish jarohatining tizimli belgilari bilan kechishidir. Ikkalasini ekspertiza xulosasida aralashtirmang.

Ko‘pincha ular mushak nekrozi allaqachon boshlangan kech bosqichni ko‘rsatadi. Ongi pasaygan bemorda ularni baholab bo‘lmaydi.
